question: The duty of respecting the National Flag and National Anthem is given in the sub-paragraph of Article 51A of Indian Constitution? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options: Article 51A (B)
Article 51A (d)
Article 51A (c)
Article 51A (a)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Article 51A (a)

Explanation:
Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution contains Article 51A (Fundamental Duties). It was added by the 42nd Amendment (1976). Sub-clause (a) of Article 51A states: "To abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem." This is a fundamental duty of every citizen of India. Fundamental duties were added on the recommendation of the Swaraj Singh Committee. There are a total of 11 fundamental duties listed under Article 51A. These duties are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced in a court of law.

☛ On whose recommendation were fundamental duties added? → Swaraj Singh Committee

☛ Fundamental duties are inspired from which country's constitution? → Russia (former Soviet Union)
question_hi: राष्ट्रीय ध्वज और राष्ट्रगान का सम्मान करने का कर्तव्य भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 51A के किस उप-अनुच्छेद में दिया गया है? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options_hi: अनुच्छेद 51A (B)
अनुच्छेद 51A (d)
अनुच्छेद 51A (c)
अनुच्छेद 51A (a)
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है अनुच्छेद 51A (a)

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान के भाग IV-A में अनुच्छेद 51A (मूल कर्तव्य) शामिल हैं। इसे 42वें संशोधन (1976) द्वारा जोड़ा गया था। अनुच्छेद 51A के उप-अनुच्छेद (a) में कहा गया है: "भारत के प्रति निष्ठा रखना और संविधान, राष्ट्रीय ध्वज तथा राष्ट्रगान का सम्मान करना।" यह भारत के प्रत्येक नागरिक का मूल कर्तव्य है। मूल कर्तव्य स्वर्ण सिंह समिति की सिफारिश पर जोड़े गए थे। कुल 11 मूल कर्तव्य हैं, जो अनुच्छेद 51A में सूचीबद्ध हैं। ये कर्तव्य गैर-न्यायसंगत हैं, अर्थात इन्हें अदालत में लागू नहीं किया जा सकता।

question: According to the plan proposed by the British Council, the Constituent Assembly was formed after the arrival of which mission? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options: Cabinet Mission
Mountbatten Mission
Simon Commission
Cripps Mission
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cabinet Mission

Explanation:
The Cabinet Mission, which arrived in India in 1946, proposed the plan for the formation of the Constituent Assembly. The mission consisted of three British cabinet members: Lord Pethick-Lawrence, Sir Stafford Cripps, and A.V. Alexander. According to the mission's proposal, the members of the Constituent Assembly were elected by the provincial legislative assemblies. The Assembly had a total of 389 members, with 292 from provinces, 93 from princely states, and 4 from chief commissioner provinces. This assembly was formed to draft the Constitution of India. The Cabinet Mission aimed to preserve India's unity and facilitate a smooth transfer of power.

question_hi: ब्रिटिश काउंसिल द्वारा प्रस्तावित योजना के अनुसार संविधान सभा का गठन किस मिशन के आगमन के बाद किया गया था? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options_hi: कैबिनेट मिशन
माउंटबेटन मिशन
साइमन कमीशन
क्रिप्स मिशन
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है कैबिनेट मिशन

Explanation:
1946 में भारत आए कैबिनेट मिशन ने संविधान सभा के गठन की योजना प्रस्तावित की थी। इस मिशन में तीन ब्रिटिश मंत्री शामिल थे: लॉर्ड पेथिक-लॉरेंस, सर स्टैफोर्ड क्रिप्स और ए.वी. अलेक्जेंडर। मिशन के प्रस्ताव के अनुसार, संविधान सभा के सदस्यों का चुनाव प्रांतीय विधानसभाओं द्वारा किया गया था। सभा में कुल 389 सदस्य थे, जिनमें 292 प्रांतों से, 93 रियासतों से और 4 मुख्य आयुक्त प्रांतों से थे। यह सभा भारत के संविधान का निर्माण करने के लिए गठित की गई थी। कैबिनेट मिशन ने भारत की एकता बनाए रखने और सत्ता हस्तांतरण की प्रक्रिया को सुचारू बनाने का प्रयास किया था।

question: Who can be appointed temporarily for the discharge of the work of the governor of the state? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options: Minister of the ruling government
Any Qualified Individual
Chief Justice of the Supreme Court
Chief Justice of the High Court
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Chief Justice of the High Court

Explanation:
According to Article 153 of the Indian Constitution, each state shall have a Governor. Article 160 empowers the President to make temporary arrangements for the discharge of the functions of the Governor. When the Governor is absent from his post due to leave or illness, the President can appoint the Chief Justice of the High Court to perform the duties of the Governor. This is a constitutional provision. The Chief Justice acts as Governor until the Governor returns or a permanent appointment is made. This ensures continuity in the state's executive functions.

☛ Article 160 → Power of temporary appointment
☛ Appointed by President → Chief Justice of High Court
☛ In absence of Governor → Chief Justice takes charge
☛ This constitutional provision → In Indian Constitution
question_hi: राज्य के राज्यपाल के कार्य के निर्वहन के लिए अस्थायी रूप से किसे नियुक्त किया जा सकता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options_hi: सत्तारूढ़ सरकार के मंत्री
कोई भी योग्य व्यक्ति
सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के मुख्य न्यायाधीश
उच्च न्यायालय के मुख्य न्यायाधीश
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है उच्च न्यायालय के मुख्य न्यायाधीश

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 153 के अनुसार प्रत्येक राज्य का एक राज्यपाल होगा। अनुच्छेद 160 राष्ट्रपति को राज्यपाल के कार्यों के निर्वहन के लिए अस्थायी प्रावधान करने की शक्ति देता है। जब राज्यपाल अपने पद से अनुपस्थित होता है, जैसे छुट्टी या बीमारी के कारण, तो राष्ट्रपति उच्च न्यायालय के मुख्य न्यायाधीश को राज्यपाल के कर्तव्यों का निर्वहन करने के लिए नियुक्त कर सकते हैं। यह एक संवैधानिक प्रावधान है। मुख्य न्यायाधीश राज्यपाल के रूप में कार्य करता है जब तक कि राज्यपाल वापस नहीं आ जाता या कोई स्थायी नियुक्ति नहीं हो जाती।

question: Who can remain in the post at the pleasure of the Governor? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options: Minister
IAS Officer
Police Officer
High Court Judge
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Minister

Explanation:
The provision of holding office during the pleasure of the Governor applies to the Chief Minister and other ministers. According to Article 164 of the Indian Constitution, ministers hold office during the pleasure of the Governor, meaning the Governor can dismiss them at any time. IAS officers, police officers, and High Court judges do not hold office at the Governor's pleasure. IAS officers are under the control of the central government, police officers are under state government, and High Court judges can be removed only through impeachment. This provision ensures accountability of ministers to the Governor.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Who holds office during the pleasure of Governor → Minister
☛ Who appoints ministers → Governor
☛ Article 164 deals with → Council of Ministers
☛ Process to remove High Court judge → Impeachment
☛ IAS officers are under control of → Central Government
question_hi: राज्यपाल की इच्छानुसार कौन पद पर बना रह सकता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019))
options_hi: मंत्री
IAS अधिकारी
पुलिस अधिकारी
उच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है मंत्री

Explanation:
राज्यपाल की इच्छानुसार पद पर बने रहने का प्रावधान मुख्यमंत्री और अन्य मंत्रियों पर लागू होता है। भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 164 के अनुसार, मंत्री राज्यपाल के प्रसादपर्यंत पद धारण करते हैं। इसका अर्थ है कि राज्यपाल किसी भी समय मंत्री को हटा सकते हैं। IAS अधिकारी, पुलिस अधिकारी और उच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश राज्यपाल की इच्छानुसार पद पर नहीं रहते। IAS अधिकारी केंद्र सरकार के नियंत्रण में होते हैं, पुलिस अधिकारी राज्य सरकार के अधीन होते हैं, और उच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश महाभियोग प्रक्रिया द्वारा ही हटाए जा सकते हैं। यह प्रावधान मंत्रियों की जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करता है।

question: Which term is used  for ending the session of Parliament for an indefinite period? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Summoning of Parliament
Adjournment
Prorogation
Adjournment sine die
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Adjournment sine die

Explanation:
Ending a session of Parliament for an indefinite period is called Adjournment sine die. This means the session is adjourned without fixing a date for reassembly. When proceedings are suspended for a specific period, it is called Adjournment. Prorogation is another process of ending a session, done by the President. Summoning is the process of starting a session.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Adjournment sine die → Termination of session for indefinite period
☛ Adjournment → Suspension for a specified period
☛ Prorogation → End of session by President
☛ Summoning → Calling a session
☛ Power to adjourn sine die → Presiding Officer (Speaker/Chairman)
question_hi: संसद के सत्र को अनिश्चित काल के लिए समाप्त करने के लिए किस शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)
options_hi: संसद का आह्वान
स्थगन
सत्रावसान
अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगन
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगन

Explanation:
संसद के सत्र को अनिश्चित काल के लिए समाप्त करने को अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगन (Adjournment sine die) कहा जाता है। इसका अर्थ है कि सत्र को बिना किसी निश्चित तिथि के स्थगित कर दिया जाता है। जब सदन की कार्यवाही को एक निश्चित अवधि के लिए स्थगित किया जाता है, तो उसे स्थगन (Adjournment) कहते हैं। सत्रावसान (Prorogation) सत्र को समाप्त करने की एक अन्य प्रक्रिया है, जो राष्ट्रपति द्वारा की जाती है। आह्वान (Summoning) सत्र शुरू करने की प्रक्रिया है।

question: Which of the following is the supreme commander of the Indian Defense Forces?   (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Prime Minister
President
Chief of the Army
Cabinet Secretary
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is President

Explanation:
According to Article 53 of the Indian Constitution, the President is the supreme commander of the Indian Defense Forces. This provision gives the President command over the Army, Navy, and Air Force. Only with the President's consent can war be declared or peace treaties signed. The Prime Minister and Council of Ministers advise the President, but the ultimate commander is the President. The Chiefs of the three services are heads of their respective forces but function under the President's authority. The Cabinet Secretary is a civil servant and not a commander of the defense forces. Therefore, the correct answer is President.

☛ Who declares war in India? → President (on the advice of the Council of Ministers)
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारतीय रक्षा बलों का सर्वोच्च कमांडर है? (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)
options_hi: प्रधान मंत्री
राष्ट्रपति
सेना प्रमुख
कैबिनेट सचिव
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है राष्ट्रपति

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 53 के अनुसार, राष्ट्रपति भारतीय रक्षा बलों का सर्वोच्च कमांडर होता है। यह प्रावधान राष्ट्रपति को सेना, नौसेना और वायु सेना की कमान देता है। राष्ट्रपति की अनुमति से ही युद्ध की घोषणा या शांति संधि की जाती है। प्रधान मंत्री और मंत्रिपरिषद राष्ट्रपति को सलाह देते हैं, लेकिन अंतिम कमांडर राष्ट्रपति ही होता है। सेना प्रमुख तीनों सेनाओं के प्रमुख होते हैं, लेकिन वे राष्ट्रपति के अधीन कार्य करते हैं। कैबिनेट सचिव एक सिविल सेवक है और रक्षा बलों का कमांडर नहीं होता। इसलिए, सही उत्तर राष्ट्रपति है।

question: The separate country of India and Pakistan was formed under _______  (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Government of India Act, 1919
Government of India Act, 1935
Indian Independence Act, 1947
Government of India Act, 1909
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Indian Independence Act, 1947

Explanation:
The formation of India and Pakistan as separate countries was carried out under the Indian Independence Act, 1947. This Act was passed by the Parliament of the United Kingdom and received royal assent on 18 July 1947. It granted independence to India on 15 August 1947 and provided for the partition of the two dominions. The Act repealed the previous Government of India Acts, including the Government of India Act, 1935, and served as an interim constitution. Under this Act, both India and Pakistan were granted the status of Dominions, with the British monarch as the head of state represented by Governor-Generals.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was the Indian Independence Act passed? → 1947
☛ Which Act did it replace? → Government of India Act, 1935

question: Which was the First Constitution to begin with a preamble?  (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)

American Constitution
British Constitution

solution:

Explanation:
The American Constitution (1787) is the first constitution in the world to begin with a preamble. Its preamble starts with the words "We the People", reflecting democracy and popular sovereignty. The preamble outlines the objectives and philosophy of the constitution, such as justice, liberty, and peace. Later, many countries, including India (1950), included a preamble in their constitutions. The Irish Constitution (1937) also has a preamble, but it came after the American Constitution. The British Constitution is unwritten and has no formal preamble.

question: _____  Is related to article 352 of the Indian Constitution. (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Budget
National Emergency
All India Services
Money Bill
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is National Emergency

Explanation:
Article 352 of the Indian Constitution deals with National Emergency. It empowers the President to declare that a grave emergency exists whereby the security of India or any part thereof is threatened by war, external aggression or armed rebellion. Such a proclamation can be made only on the recommendation of the Cabinet and must be approved by Parliament. During a National Emergency, Fundamental Rights (except Articles 20 and 21) can be suspended and the distribution of powers between Centre and States shifts in favour of the Centre. So far, National Emergency has been imposed three times: in 1962 (China war), 1971 (Pakistan war), and 1975-77 (internal disturbance). Emergency under Article 352 is called National Emergency, whereas Articles 356 and 360 deal with State and Financial Emergencies respectively.

☛ Article 360 → Financial Emergency

The framers of the Indian Constitution incorporated them with the aim of making India a welfare state. DPSP are non-justiciable in nature and promote the idea of a welfare state. They provide essential guidelines for the government to ensure justice, liberty, and equality for all citizens.

question: The format of the parliamentary system of government described in the Indian Constitution was drafted on the basis of which constitution? (RPF Constable 2018 (09/02/2019))
options: French Formats
Soviet Formats
British format
U.S. Format
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is British format

Explanation:
The parliamentary system in India is based on the British Westminster system. In this system, the executive is responsible to the legislature. The President is the constitutional head, while the Prime Minister is the real executive head. This system is inspired by the unwritten conventions and practices of the British Constitution. The framers of the Indian Constitution adopted it because it ensures stable government and democratic accountability. In a parliamentary system, the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Parliament. The main reason for adopting this system in India was prior experience under British rule.

question: Members of the Rajya Sabha are: (RPF Constable 2018 (09/02/2019))
options: Elected by the public

solution:

Explanation:
Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Indian Parliament. Its members are indirectly elected by the elected members of the Legislative Assemblies of states and union territories. question: According to the Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) 1956 passed by the Indian Parliament, into how many sections have industries been divided? (RPF Constable 2018 (09/02/2019))
options: Four Categories
Five Classes
Two Classes
Three Categories
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Three Categories

Explanation:
The Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) 1956 was the foundation of India's industrial development strategy. It classified industries into three categories: Schedule A included industries exclusively under state control (like railways, defense, atomic energy); Schedule B comprised mixed sector industries where the state could gradually involve private sector; and Schedule C included the remaining industries open to private sector. This policy guided India's industrial framework from 1956 to 1991 and reinforced the socialist structure. The classification aimed to ensure the state's role in economic development and reduce regional disparities. The IPR 1956 was a key step in implementing the Mahalanobis model of heavy industrialization and laid the groundwork for the public sector's dominance in core industries.

question: Indian Constitution adopts universal adult suffrage as the basis of the Lok Sabha elections. Every citizen who is not less than _____ has the right to vote (RPF Constable 2018 (09/02/2019) Shift 2)

21 years
